subject: pol-dym
title: (R)POL.DYM.------TRS.
description: Diagram in MID-W-3, paired with v1-p409-1. (R)POL-DYM (the reality of political dynamics) is crossed with TRS (transition). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) branches from the main line; CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts) branches from ALT-F and opens into RE-ST (restructuralism), and GRAD (gradualism) branches from ALT-F and opens into DOC (documentation). DEC (decentralization) branches from the main line and opens into MT-TFS-AT (multi-transfer-shift activity).
